about: Cases that pin `nthChild` to upstream ast-grep 0.45.3 (`rule/nth_child.rs`): the 1-based position among the parent's named children (comments count), as a number or `An+B`; `ofRule` counts only the siblings it matches and keeps the node's own bindings; `reverse` counts from the last. Each case runs through the CLI and both Rerail paths.
